title: Effect of Mutations on Smlt1473 Binding to Various Substrates Using Molecular Dynamics Simulations
authors: Kinjal Mondal; Samantha Felton; Bryan W. Berger; Jeffery B. Klauda
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接、MD模拟和机器学习聚类研究多糖裂解酶Smlt1473突变体与底物结合，属广义蛋白-配体互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD+ML方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Smlt1473 is a polysaccharide lyase from Stenotrophomonas maltophilia whose crystal structure was solved recently using X-ray crystallography. There was an effort to study the effect of mutations on the activity of Smlt1473 binding to various substrates like hyaluronic acid(HA), mannuronic acid(ManA), and alginate. In this study, we use molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the effect of binding of various substrates (HA and ManA) to Smlt1473 and two of its mutants H221F and R312L. We further studied the stability in the binding of Smlt1473 to its various substrates as well as the role of fluctuations. Machine-Learning based clustering algorithms were used to group the entire simulation trajectory into various stable states. The molecular interactions Smlt1473 to the substrates were calculated and the importance of specific residues were tested with observed activity assays due to residue mutations. Overall, we find that the R218 plays an important role in substrate binding and thus impacting the activity due to the H221F mutant and R/L312 itself plays an important role in the R312 mutation. In addition, we have also found three more residues K56, R107, and R164 important for substrate binding which we further proceed to confirm using wet lab mutagenesis studies.
abstract_zh: Smlt1473是一种来自嗜麦芽寡养单胞菌（Stenotrophomonas maltophilia）的多糖裂解酶，其晶体结构最近通过X射线晶体学解析。已有研究致力于探讨突变对Smlt1473与多种底物（如透明质酸（HA）、甘露糖醛酸（ManA）和海藻酸盐）结合活性的影响。在本研究中，我们利用分子对接和分子动力学模拟，考察了不同底物（HA和ManA）与Smlt1473及其两个突变体H221F和R312L结合的影响。我们进一步研究了Smlt1473与其多种底物结合的稳定性以及波动的作用。基于机器学习的聚类算法被用于将整个模拟轨迹分组为多种稳定状态。计算了Smlt1473与底物的分子相互作用，并通过观察到的活性测定验证了特定残基因突变的重要性。总体而言，我们发现R218在底物结合中发挥重要作用，从而影响H221F突变体的活性，而R/L312本身在R312突变中起关键作用。此外，我们还发现了另外三个残基K56、R107和R164对底物结合至关重要，并通过湿实验室诱变研究进一步确认了这些发现。
